evidence.title: Compose real local Event Search → Inspection → separately authorized Pivot Query draft → Search return
evidence.goal: Deliver one meaningful bounded analyst journey reusing the source-identical browser-to-Go Inspection bridge from immutable #185 and the L2-corrected host action authorization from #189. A selected authorized Event field prepares a read-only CAP-INV-002 Query draft with validated provenance and restored Search context; never execute/persist a Query.
outputs: An actual user-selected field from the existing Inspector becomes a server-revalidated, unexecuted Query draft with source provenance/time/return context.
Original frontend JavaScript and Go fixture are connected through actual Node fetch to Go HTTP with distinct synthetic host PivotAuthorizer.
Existing Inspector source information and return to identical Search window remain available, including action denied and stale route cancellation.
Exact-SHA three-platform Go and Node frontend tests, bounded transport and compulsory engineering-kernel checks.
acceptance_tests: Actual loopback Go host permits `source.ip` pivot only with distinct host-authorized action; binds Search Job, Event, tenant and origin, and preserves the client-supplied time range (syntactic validation only, no trusted Search Job interval comparison); no Query execution.
A different visible enrichment is denied by independent PivotAuthorizer and does not reveal raw secret or partial draft.
A raw-denied `secret.token` is not a pivot option; forged host pivot field origin or return context is rejected client-side.
Concurrent/cancelled pivot after return to Search yields superseded and cannot restore previously drafted data.
Prior Go Inspector HTTP and full Node Event Search suites pass on same exact integration SHA.
Mandatory security, coverage, formatting, architecture and manifest CI verified before L2 and any merge.

rules: Canonical: Investigate CAP-INV-004 §12 Pivoter Class-0, §17 Inspector→Search and §25; consumer CAP-INV-002 Query draft/return to exactly selected authorized Search window. Shared owns Telemetry Event, Search Job and Query; Settings owns Parser/Data Source. OPEN-013/OPEN-014 and real Query execution explicitly excluded.

Engineering: existing E10-INV-004 epic; task K depends on H-HTTPBRIDGE and J-PIVOTFIX, both IMPLEMENTED, *not* product ACCEPTED. No new policy engine. The existing source H historical manifest and handoff were imported unchanged.

Code: first-party ES modules under product-runtime/event-search-frontend and Go host's *loopback test-only* fixture. Existing Go API host in product-runtime/event-inspection-host, modified previously in #189, remains exactly unchanged in this integration.

Git: base PR #189 SHA 0393782e75f8a94705ea8f5256421f96715c02c0 on PR #186, itself based on #184. Seven original blobs inspection.mjs, inspection.test.mjs, inspection-http.mjs, inspection-http.test.mjs, package.json, Go fixture and browser HTTP workflow were imported bit-for-bit from PR #185 frozen SHA d1544e255b9d595357c3f6ed2c2cf23a270f247a in initial integration commit 4a037e9f85df073e67c77ac891d4adcc4b51d9bd. Original #185 and #189 HEADs unchanged. Implementation extends the new candidate only.
